mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order ( order_id, user_id, goods_id, goods_name, goods_image_url, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, pay_price, status, out_trade_no, biz_id, notify_type, notify_url, market_type, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsName}, #{goodsImageUrl}, #{source}, #{channel}, #{originalPrice}, #{deductionPrice}, #{payPrice}, #{status}, #{outTradeNo}, #{bizId}, #{notifyType}, #{notifyUrl}, #{marketType}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, user_id, goods_id, goods_name, goods_image_url, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, pay_price, status, out_trade_no, out_trade_time, pay_url, biz_id, notify_type, notify_url, market_type, create_time, update_time FROM t_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_id, user_id, goods_id, goods_name, goods_image_url, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, pay_price, status, out_trade_no, out_trade_time, pay_url, biz_id, notify_type, notify_url, market_type, create_time, update_time FROM t_order WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT out_trade_no FROM t_order WHERE status = 0 AND NOW() >= create_time + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET status = 1, out_trade_time = #{outTradeTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status = 0
UPDATE t_order SET status = 6, update_time = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status = 5
UPDATE t_order SET status = 7, update_time = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status = 6
UPDATE t_order SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status IN (1, 2)
UPDATE t_order SET status = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status = 0
UPDATE t_order SET status = 4, update_time = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status = 3
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, user_id, goods_id, goods_name, goods_image_url, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, pay_price, status, out_trade_no, out_trade_time, pay_url, biz_id, notify_type, notify_url, market_type, create_time, update_time FROM t_order WHERE status = 5 ORDER BY update_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{count}
